mapper.sql: SELECT d.*, o.order_no, c.name AS customer_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, t.doc_no AS trade_doc_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name, pu.nickname AS pick_by_name, wv.wave_no, (SELECT SUM(i.qty) FROM scm_delivery_item i WHERE i.delivery_id = d.id) AS total_qty FROM scm_delivery d JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = d.order_id JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = d.customer_id JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN scm_trade_doc t ON t.id = d.trade_doc_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = d.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pu.id = d.pick_by LEFT JOIN scm_wave wv ON wv.id = d.wave_id
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled FROM scm_delivery_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.delivery_id = #{deliveryId} ORDER BY i.id

SELECT p.*, l.code AS location_code, b.expiry_date, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.unit FROM scm_delivery_pick p JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = p.location_id LEFT JOIN wms_batch b ON b.material_id = p.material_id AND b.batch_no = p.batch_no AND p.batch_no <> '' WHERE p.delivery_id = #{deliveryId} ORDER BY p.delivery_item_id, p.id

SELECT i.order_item_id AS "orderItemId", SUM(i.qty) AS "qty" FROM scm_delivery_item i JOIN scm_delivery d ON d.id = i.delivery_id WHERE d.order_id = #{orderId} AND d.status IN ('PENDING', 'PICKED') GROUP BY i.order_item_id
